title: Origin story: Momotaro
description: Momotaro was born from a giant peach that floated down the river to a childless old couple. Eating the best millet dumplings, he grew strong, and set out for Ogre Island with a dog, a monkey, and a pheasant as companions, sharing his dumplings to win their loyalty.

description: Ranked abilities: Diplomacy (dumpling-based) — rank 100/100; Courage — rank 95/100; Kindness — rank 94/100; Leadership — rank 92/100; Strength — rank 90/100.

title: Power ranking: Momotaro
description: Powers: The peach's miraculous birth-strength; Three loyal companions; Millet dumplings that win any ally.

title: Stamina feats: Momotaro
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Crossed the sea to Ogre Island; Faced the ogre king in his own fortress.

title: Crossover notes: Momotaro
description: Momotaro crosses naturally with: courage, friendship, ogre-slaying.

title: Cultural impact: Momotaro
description: Japan's most beloved folk hero; the peach boy's tale is told to every child.
